verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform, so network isolation between environments is a fair axis. The evidence documents unlimited environments, per-PR previews and private connections. None of it states that non-production environments are network-isolated from, or blocked from reaching, production services. Environment creation and private networking are adjacent features, not the isolation capability itself.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
